newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares dip in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares dip in light trade.

text.p: Estonian shares maintained quieter levels of trade on Monday after last week's hectic rally and the market's stock index dipped.
Total official list turnover was just 10.8 million kroons and the Tallinn stock exchange index dipped 0.27 percent to 130.83.
Market leader Hansapank led the market on activity of 6.3 million kroons and it closed at 131.55 kroons after Friday's 133.25 kroons.
Forekspank also saw healthy activity and turned over 2.17 million kroons and ended at 82.85 kroons versus 82.95 kroons.

On the over-the-counter free market, activity came to 3.4 million kroons with the Kalev confectionary market well traded on turnover of 703,276 kroons and its price dipping to 596 kroons from 612 kroons.
